apply_style_to_node.description: Apply a local style to a node.
apply_style_to_node.name: apply_style_to_node

batch_execute_pipeline.description: Run several write steps in order. A step can use an earlier step's result via $variables. With stop_on_error, a failure undoes created nodes and changed properties. It cannot undo deletes, group/ungroup, detach, reparent, or steps that target nodes by name.

steps.description: Steps in order: {id, action, params, export_vars?}

action.description: Tool name to run e.g. create_frame

id.description: Step ID, used by $variables in later steps

stop_on_error.description: Stop and undo on error (default true)

batch_execute_pipeline.name: batch_execute_pipeline

batch_rename_nodes.description: Rename nodes: set `name`, or use find/replace (regex allowed) or prefix/suffix. `name` cannot mix with the others.

find.description: Text or regex to find in names

name.description: New name for all nodes; slashes group e.g. 'Icons/Arrow'

batch_rename_nodes.name: batch_rename_nodes

boolean_operation.description: Combine 2+ shapes (same parent): UNION, SUBTRACT (cut the rest from the first), INTERSECT, or EXCLUDE. Pipeline rollback cannot undo it.

nodeIds.description: Shape IDs; order matters for SUBTRACT

boolean_operation.name: boolean_operation

clone_node.description: Copy a node, optionally to a new position or parent.
clone_node.name: clone_node

combine_as_variants.description: Combine 2+ components (same parent) into a component set of variants. Then add VARIANT properties with manage_component_properties.
combine_as_variants.name: combine_as_variants

create_component.description: Turn a FRAME into a COMPONENT, in place.
create_component.name: create_component

create_component_instance.description: Create an instance of a local component (componentId) or library component (componentKey). A component set uses its default variant.
create_component_instance.name: create_component_instance

create_connector.description: Create a connector line. FigJam only.
create_connector.name: create_connector

create_node.description: Create a shape. Arguments per `type`: FRAME: width, height, fillColor, auto layout args. RECTANGLE: width, height, fillColor, cornerRadius. ELLIPSE: width, height, fillColor, startAngle, endAngle, innerRadiusRatio. STAR: pointCount, outerRadius, innerRadius, fillColor, cornerRadius. POLYGON: pointCount, radius, fillColor, cornerRadius. LINE: length, rotation, strokeColor, strokeWeight. SECTION: width, height (no parent). All: x, y, name. Wrong args for the type are rejected. For text use create_text.

counterAxisAlignItems.description: Cross axis align: MIN, CENTER, MAX, BASELINE

counterAxisSizingMode.description: Cross axis size: FIXED or AUTO (hug)

layoutAlign.description: This node's cross axis align in the parent's auto layout

layoutGrow.description: 1 = grow to fill the parent's main axis, 0 = keep size

layoutMode.description: Auto layout: HORIZONTAL, VERTICAL, or NONE

layoutPositioning.description: In the parent's auto layout: AUTO (in flow) or ABSOLUTE (free, at x/y)

layoutSizingHorizontal.description: Width mode: FIXED, HUG (fit content), or FILL (fill parent). Prefer over *AxisSizingMode. HUG needs auto layout on this node; FILL on its parent.

layoutSizingVertical.description: Height mode: FIXED, HUG, or FILL. Same rules as layoutSizingHorizontal.

primaryAxisAlignItems.description: Main axis align: MIN, CENTER, MAX, SPACE_BETWEEN

primaryAxisSizingMode.description: Main axis size: FIXED or AUTO (hug)

type.description: FRAME, RECTANGLE, ELLIPSE, STAR, POLYGON, LINE, or SECTION

create_node.name: create_node

create_style.description: Create a local style. Arguments per `type`: PAINT: color. TEXT: fontSize, fontFamily, fontStyle, textDecoration, lineHeightValue/Unit, letterSpacingValue/Unit. EFFECT: effectType, color, opacity, radius, offsetX, offsetY, spread. GRID: pattern, count, gutterSize, offset, alignment, sectionSize, color, opacity. Returns the style ID; apply with apply_style_to_node.

color.description: Hex. PAINT: required. EFFECT: default #000000. GRID: default #FF0000.

create_style.name: create_style

create_text.description: Create a text node. Loads the font for you. To edit existing text use set_text.

fontStyle.description: Font style e.g. 'Bold' (default Regular). Must exist for the family.

create_text.name: create_text

create_vector.description: Create a vector from SVG markup, e.g. an icon. Several paths become a frame of vectors.
create_vector.name: create_vector

delete_nodes.description: Delete nodes. Cannot be undone from here.
delete_nodes.name: delete_nodes

detach_instance.description: Detach instances into plain frames. Looks the same, no link to the component.
detach_instance.name: detach_instance

export_frames_to_pdf.description: Export frames as one PDF file, one page per frame, in order.

outputPath.description: Path of the .pdf file, inside the working directory

export_frames_to_pdf.name: export_frames_to_pdf

export_screenshots.description: Export nodes as images. Items with outputPath are saved to file; others are returned (PNG/JPG as image, SVG as text, PDF as base64). Omit items to export the selection. Use outputPath if you only need the file.

format.description: Default format: PNG (default), SVG, JPG, PDF

items.description: {nodeId, outputPath?, format?, scale?}. Omit to export the selection.

outputPath.description: File to save to. Omit to return the image.

scale.description: Default scale for PNG/JPG (2 for files, 1 when returned)

export_screenshots.name: export_screenshots

export_tokens.description: Export variables and paint styles as JSON or CSS variables.
export_tokens.name: export_tokens

find_replace_text.description: Find and replace text in TEXT nodes, on the current page or inside nodeId.

nodeId.description: Search inside this node (default: current page)

find_replace_text.name: find_replace_text

flatten_nodes.description: Merge nodes (same parent) into one vector. Pipeline rollback cannot undo it.
flatten_nodes.name: flatten_nodes

get_annotations.description: Get Dev Mode annotations on the current page, or on one node and its children.

nodeId.description: Only this node and its children

get_annotations.name: get_annotations

get_document.description: Get the node tree of the selection, the current page, or the whole file (`scope`). Returns {fileName, scope, currentPage, nodes}. Full detail stops at 500 nodes by default. If cut short, the result has `truncated`, and nodes with hidden children show `childCount`.

dedupe_components.description: Show instances in short form (mainComponentId, componentProperties, overrides) and list each component once in `componentDefs`. Saves tokens on screens with many instances.

depth.description: Levels below each root. 0 = root only. Default 2 for selection, no limit otherwise.

detail.description: minimal: id/name/type/bounds. compact: + fills/strokes/opacity. full (default): everything. Use lower levels for big files.

maxNodes.description: Max nodes in full detail (default 500). Not used with `detail` or dedupe_components.

scope.description: page (default): current page. document: every page, one shared maxNodes limit. selection: selected nodes, 2 levels deep by default; uses the page if nothing is selected. Best for exploring.

get_document.name: get_document

get_fonts.description: List fonts used on the current page, most used first.
get_fonts.name: get_fonts

get_image_bytes.description: Get the original image files used in nodes' image fills, as base64. For a picture of how a node looks, use export_screenshots. Each image is returned once; nodes without images are listed in `skipped`.
get_image_bytes.name: get_image_bytes

get_instance_overrides.description: Get an instance's component properties (variant, boolean, text) with types and current values. Use before set_instance_overrides.
get_instance_overrides.name: get_instance_overrides

get_local_components.description: Get all components in the file.
get_local_components.name: get_local_components

get_metadata.description: Get file name, current page, and every page's ID and name. Cheap: loads no node trees.
get_metadata.name: get_metadata

get_nodes_info.description: Get full details of nodes by ID. Returns {nodes}, plus globalVars.styles when fills or strokes repeat. Unknown IDs are listed in `missing`. Stops at 500 descendants by default; if cut short, has `truncated` and `childCount`.

depth.description: Levels below each node. 0 = the nodes only. Default no limit.

get_nodes_info.name: get_nodes_info

get_reactions.description: Get a node's prototype reactions: each has a trigger (e.g. ON_CLICK) and actions. Change them with set_reactions.
get_reactions.name: get_reactions

get_selection.description: Get the selected nodes, or the nodes pinned in the plugin panel. Empty array if none. For more detail use get_nodes_info.

source.description: selection (default): what is selected now; changes when the user clicks. pinned: set saved in the panel; stays the same across calls.

get_selection.name: get_selection

get_styles.description: Get all local styles (paint, text, effect, grid) with ID, name, type and values. For variables use get_variable_defs.
get_styles.name: get_styles

get_variable_defs.description: Get all local variables (design tokens): collections, modes and values.
get_variable_defs.name: get_variable_defs

get_viewport.description: Get the viewport center, zoom, and visible bounds.
get_viewport.name: get_viewport

group_nodes.description: Group 2+ nodes that share a parent.
group_nodes.name: group_nodes

import_image.description: Add an image from a URL (preferred) or base64. Creates a rectangle sized to the image, or fills an existing node if nodeId is set.

crop.description: Part of the image to show, {x, y, width, height} each 0-1. Sets scaleMode CROP.

imageData.description: Base64 PNG or JPG, if no URL

mode.description: With nodeId: replace fills (default) or append

nodeId.description: Fill this node with the image instead of making a rectangle

import_image.name: import_image

manage_component_properties.description: Add, edit, delete, or bind a component's properties. bind links a layer to a property: BOOLEAN shows/hides it, TEXT sets its text, INSTANCE_SWAP swaps it. Names work without the '#1:2' suffix.

defaultValue.description: Default, for add: boolean, string, or component ID (INSTANCE_SWAP)

type.description: Type, for add. VARIANT needs a COMPONENT_SET.

manage_component_properties.name: manage_component_properties

manage_page.description: Add, delete, rename, or go to a page. Arguments per `action`: add: name, index. delete: pageId or pageName. rename: pageId or pageName, plus newName. navigate: pageId or pageName. List pages with get_metadata.

pageName.description: Exact page name, instead of pageId

manage_page.name: manage_page

manage_plugin_data.description: Store string key/values on a node, saved in the file (e.g. which source file a component maps to). Use JSON for complex values.
manage_plugin_data.name: manage_plugin_data

manage_variable.description: Manage variables (design tokens). Arguments per `action`: create_collection: name, initialModeName. add_mode: collectionId, modeName. create: name, collectionId, type, value. set_value: variableId, modeId, value. delete: variableId, or collectionId (deletes all its variables). bind: nodeId, variableId, field (link a node property to the variable). Get IDs from get_variable_defs. Free plan allows 1 mode per collection: if add_mode fails with 'Limited to 1 modes only', do not retry; put the mode in the name instead (e.g. 'light/bg', 'dark/bg') and tell the user multi-mode needs a paid plan.

action.description: create_collection, add_mode, create, set_value, delete, or bind

field.description: Property to bind. COLOR: fillColor, strokeColor. BOOLEAN: visible. FLOAT: opacity, rotation, width, height, cornerRadius, topLeftRadius, topRightRadius, bottomLeftRadius, bottomRightRadius, strokeWeight, itemSpacing, paddingTop, paddingRight, paddingBottom, paddingLeft.

name.description: Collection or variable name; slashes group e.g. 'Color/Primary'

value.description: COLOR: hex. FLOAT: number. STRING: text. BOOLEAN: true/false. For create, sets the first mode.

manage_variable.name: manage_variable

outline_stroke.description: Turn each node's stroke into a filled shape. Nodes without a stroke are listed in `skipped`.
outline_stroke.name: outline_stroke

reparent_nodes.description: Move nodes into another frame, group, or section.
reparent_nodes.name: reparent_nodes

save_version_checkpoint.description: Save a named version in the file history. Use before big or risky changes. Design files only.
save_version_checkpoint.name: save_version_checkpoint

search_nodes.description: Find nodes by name, type, or both. Searches the current page by default. Returns up to `limit` (default 50) and sets `truncated` if there were more.

includeHidden.description: Search hidden nodes (default true). false skips hidden nodes and their children.

includeText.description: Add characters, fontSize and fontName to TEXT results (default false).

nodeId.description: Search only inside this node. Overrides scope.

query.description: Text to find in node names (case-insensitive). Omit to match all nodes of `types`.

scope.description: page (default) or document (every page). A page search does not look at other pages.

search_nodes.name: search_nodes

set_annotations.description: Set Dev Mode annotations on nodes ([] clears). Needs a paid Dev Mode seat.
set_annotations.name: set_annotations

set_auto_layout.description: Set auto layout (flexbox) on frames, components or instances: direction, padding, gap, align, and sizing (HUG/FILL via layoutSizing*). layoutPositioning, layoutAlign and layoutGrow set how a node sits in its parent. Each node reports its own result.

counterAxisAlignItems.description: Cross axis align: MIN, CENTER, MAX, BASELINE

counterAxisSizingMode.description: Cross axis size: FIXED or AUTO (hug)

layoutAlign.description: This node's cross axis align in the parent's auto layout

layoutGrow.description: 1 = grow to fill the parent's main axis, 0 = keep size

layoutMode.description: Auto layout: HORIZONTAL, VERTICAL, or NONE

layoutPositioning.description: In the parent's auto layout: AUTO (in flow) or ABSOLUTE (free, at x/y)

layoutSizingHorizontal.description: Width mode: FIXED, HUG (fit content), or FILL (fill parent). Prefer over *AxisSizingMode. HUG needs auto layout on this node; FILL on its parent.

layoutSizingVertical.description: Height mode: FIXED, HUG, or FILL. Same rules as layoutSizingHorizontal.

primaryAxisAlignItems.description: Main axis align: MIN, CENTER, MAX, SPACE_BETWEEN

primaryAxisSizingMode.description: Main axis size: FIXED or AUTO (hug)

set_auto_layout.name: set_auto_layout

set_codegen_result.description: Save code on a node to show in Dev Mode's Code panel for the whole team. Code on a component shows for all its instances. [] removes it.

language.description: e.g. TYPESCRIPT, HTML, CSS, SWIFT, KOTLIN (default PLAINTEXT)

set_codegen_result.name: set_codegen_result

set_effects.description: Replace a node's effects. [] clears them. Same shape as styles.effects from get_nodes_info.

effects.description: Effects by `type`. DROP_SHADOW / INNER_SHADOW: color, opacity, offsetX, offsetY, radius, spread, blendMode; showShadowBehindNode on drop shadows. LAYER_BLUR / BACKGROUND_BLUR: radius; blurType PROGRESSIVE adds startRadius, startOffset, endOffset as {x, y}. NOISE: noiseType (MONOTONE default | DUOTONE | MULTITONE), color, opacity, blendMode, noiseSize, density; secondaryColor for DUOTONE, noiseOpacity for MULTITONE. TEXTURE: noiseSize, radius, clipToShape. GLASS: radius, depth, lightIntensity, lightAngle, refraction, dispersion. visible defaults to true.

set_effects.name: set_effects

set_export_settings.description: Set the Export presets shown in a node's right panel. Does not export a file; use export_screenshots for that.

constraint.description: Size for PNG/JPG: {type: SCALE|WIDTH|HEIGHT, value}. SCALE 2 = @2x.

contentsOnly.description: Skip content that overlaps from outside (default true)

useAbsoluteBounds.description: Use full bounds even if the parent clips the node

set_export_settings.name: set_export_settings

set_instance_overrides.description: Set component properties (variant, boolean, text) on an instance. Fails on unknown names or wrong types.

properties.description: Name to value e.g. {"Size": "Large", "Show Icon": true}

set_instance_overrides.name: set_instance_overrides

set_layout_grids.description: Set layout grids (columns, rows, or square grid) on frames. [] removes them.
set_layout_grids.name: set_layout_grids

set_node_properties.description: Set any node properties: position, size, radius, visibility, lock, opacity, rotation, blend, constraints, z-order, mask, stroke. Pass only what to change. Each node reports what was applied.

constraints.description: {horizontal, vertical}: MIN, MAX, CENTER, STRETCH, or SCALE

isMask.description: Use as mask for the layers above it

order.description: Layer order: bringToFront, sendToBack, bringForward, sendBackward

strokeCap.description: Line ends: NONE, ROUND, SQUARE, ARROW_LINES, ARROW_EQUILATERAL

set_node_properties.name: set_node_properties

set_paint.description: Set a node's fill or stroke. SOLID: color, opacity. GRADIENT_LINEAR/GRADIENT_RADIAL: stops, geometry, opacity (fill only).

geometry.description: GRADIENT: in percentX/percentY. Linear: start, end, angle. Radial: center, radius, rotation.

set_paint.name: set_paint

set_reactions.description:
Set or remove prototype reactions. mode: replace (default) or append. To remove, pass removeIndices (from get_reactions; [] = all) instead of reactions.
Reaction: {"trigger":{"type":...},"actions":[...]}.
Triggers: ON_CLICK, ON_HOVER, ON_PRESS, ON_DRAG, AFTER_TIMEOUT (+timeout ms), MOUSE_ENTER, MOUSE_LEAVE, MOUSE_UP, MOUSE_DOWN.
Actions: NODE (+destinationId, navigation NAVIGATE|OVERLAY|SCROLL_TO|SWAP|CHANGE_TO, transition, preserveScrollPosition), BACK, CLOSE, URL (+url).
Transitions: DISSOLVE, SMART_ANIMATE, or PUSH, MOVE_IN, MOVE_OUT, SLIDE_IN, SLIDE_OUT (these also need direction LEFT|RIGHT|TOP|BOTTOM and matchLayers).
Example: {"nodeId":"1:2","reactions":[{"trigger":{"type":"ON_CLICK"},"actions":[{"type":"NODE","destinationId":"1:3","navigation":"NAVIGATE","transition":{"type":"DISSOLVE","duration":0.3,"easing":{"type":"EASE_OUT"}},"preserveScrollPosition":false}]}]}

removeIndices.description: Indices to remove; [] removes all. Not with reactions.

set_reactions.name: set_reactions

set_selection.description: Select nodes and zoom to them, switching page if needed. Use it to show the user your work. No IDs clears the selection. Nodes must be on one page.

select.description: Change selection (default true). false + zoom only moves the view.

set_selection.name: set_selection

set_text.description: Change a TEXT node's text and whole-node settings (resize, truncation, alignment, spacing). To style part of the text use set_text_ranges.

textAutoResize.description: NONE (fixed), HEIGHT (grow down), WIDTH_AND_HEIGHT (hug), or TRUNCATE

set_text.name: set_text

set_text_ranges.description: Style parts of a TEXT node (bold word, color, link, list). Each range covers characters [start, end) of the current text. Later ranges win where they overlap. Omitted properties stay the same.

ranges.description: Ranges to style; start and end required

set_text_ranges.name: set_text_ranges

swap_component.description: Swap an instance to another component, keeping position and size.
swap_component.name: swap_component

ungroup_nodes.description: Ungroup GROUP nodes; children move to the parent.
ungroup_nodes.name: ungroup_nodes

update_paint_style.description: Update a paint style's name, color, or description. Other style types: delete and create again.
update_paint_style.name: update_paint_style
